user.title: Masjid 24/7
user.description:
Enter the Masjid ID of each masjid you want prayer times for. Separate several with commas, for example 965, 2093.

To find a masjid's ID, search for it on [masjid247.com/clock/setup]({setup_url}) and press **Add**: the number shown next to it is its Masjid ID.

data_description.masjids: One or more Masjid IDs, separated by commas.

error.invalid_ids: Enter Masjid IDs as numbers, separated by commas (for example 965, 2093).
error.too_many: You can add up to 10 masjids.
error.not_found: No prayer timetable was found for masjid {ids}. Check the number on masjid247.com/clock/setup.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Masjid 24/7 prayer-time server. Please try again in a minute.
